title: The Ripple
coreMessage: The ripple can stop with you.

openingTutorial.purpose: Teach that a negative response creates a new Monster without removing the original Monster.

playerControlledStory.purpose: Let the player choose whether negative emotion propagates or stops.

main.purpose: Follows the current player-controlled character and active encounter.

side.purpose: Preserves characters who leave the main frame so their stories can continue independently.

continuityRules: Characters retain their canonical appearance, clothing, and distinctive features.
A host's Monster remains attached until an approved state transition changes it.
Characters leaving the main frame continue to exist in saved world state.
Only the shared state engine may approve Monster creation, shrinking, or removal.
Fresh scenes must be rebuilt from saved canonical and runtime state.
